timeline.text: Okay, so here's how it works. In Japan, everything costs thousands. Thousands! So the yen must be super valuable.
...What? Why are you doing the eyebrow?
Ryan. It's the opposite. Prices look big because each yen is tiny. One yen is a little over half a cent.
So I've been bragging about being rich... in pennies.
Okay, but they're very nice pennies. Some of them have holes in them!
